response.rationale: All options are unmatched. Ranking is based on clinical closeness to the top leaf 'Subcorneal pustular dermatosis (Sneddon-Wilkinson)' and the vignette. Actinic folliculitis and Acne aestivalis both involve folliculitis and pustules exacerbated by sun, aligning more closely with the vignette's description of pustular eruptions exacerbated by sunlight. Polymorphous light eruption, pustular variant, is also sun-related but less specifically follicular. Eosinophilic folliculitis is a distinct entity not strongly supported by the provided information.
